body: It looks like visual studio has a problem with some non-English locales, showing C2001 - newline embedded in string - when the user code page is not utf-8-friendly (I found reports regarding some east-asian locales, and hebrew). I'm guessing that UTF-8 is assumed in most other environments, so I think it's fine to try this fix.
